verdict.rationale: Gitea's own GitHub README says it ships an official Go SDK, and it exposes an API that SDK-based builds can target. The evidence is a single thin mention of one language, and the OpenAPI probes at the docs domain all returned 404. Missing for 10: official SDKs in languages beyond Go, SDK documentation or usage guides, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
